definition: The American artificial intelligence (AI) organization OpenAI has released a variety of products and applications since its founding in 2015..
details: The American artificial intelligence (AI) organization OpenAI has released a variety of products and applications since its founding in 2015.

explainer.lead: OpenAI has released a range of AI products and applications since its founding in 2015, spanning reinforcement-learning research tools and later systems. Its early RL work positioned it as a notable competitor to DeepMind.

tiers.eli5: Since 2015, OpenAI has built and shared many AI tools, from practice playgrounds for training computer agents to the products people use today.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers can build on OpenAI's open-source RL libraries, such as Gym, which standardized how environments are defined so published research is easier to reproduce. A pitfall is that development of Gym moved to a successor library, Gymnasium, in 2022, so older tutorials may not match current APIs.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, Gym is an open-source Python library (announced 2016) that standardizes environment definition for reinforcement-learning research; its limits include the 2022 migration of new development to Gymnasium.

explainer.example: A researcher wanting to train an RL agent defines a task as a Gym environment, runs the algorithm against it, and can then share the setup so others reproduce the result.
